Refinement from Jack Heart (2026-11-22) on Fork #6 (read-only first vs admin controls):

"also i think we will definintely want admin controls eventually but lets start with a read-only version so i can share it on the web more easily"

Key implications:
- Start with a strictly read-only live view so it can be shared on the web easily without auth/mutation risk.
- Design the server/UI boundaries so gated admin controls (cancel runs, terminate machines) layer in cleanly later behind auth.
